snippet.title: PROJECT LLL Gameplay Demo 15 Minutes 8K
snippet.description:
Project LLL Gameplay Demo included with screenshots, game info and game news with my commentary in 8K ULTRA HD quality and smooth 60 FPS for PC, next-gen consoles, all edited by me.

Release Date: Expected 2025

Project LLL is an ambitious upcoming open-world MMO shooter by NCSOFT, blending elements of science fiction and historical settings in a vast, futuristic Earth. With a focus on large-scale PvE and PvP combat, Project LLL introduces players to a hybrid of shooter and MMO gameplay where they can experience a blend of cooperative missions, faction warfare, and exploration across different timelines. More info in the video.

14:20 - Outro
